purpose: Durable cross-chat handoff state for ChatGPT-assisted OVMS Agent development. Read this file first in a new chat, then verify live GitHub branch/issue state before acting.

user_rules.agent_prompt_prefix: When giving lines to paste into OVMS Agent, omit the OVMS-AGENT> prompt prefix.
user_rules.vax_external_identifier_limit: Treat DEC C/VAX 31-character external identifier limit as hard. Audit every newly introduced externally visible function/global/linker-visible symbol before packaging every milestone/fix.
user_rules.vax_c_compatibility: Avoid implicit function declarations and non-C89 constructs in VAX-facing C.
user_rules.github_source_of_truth: Use connected GitHub as source of truth for committed repository files, searches, branches, diffs, issues, PRs, comments, and history. Ask user for OpenVMS commands only for runtime/build/RMS/DCL/live acceptance evidence GitHub cannot provide.
user_rules.project_isolation: Do not mix OVMS Agent build architecture with VMSBBS or other projects. Preserve accepted root-level modular build architecture and rejected-file deletions.
user_rules.interaction: User prefers exact pasteable DCL commands and concrete next steps; often says proceed. Do not ask for information already supplied.

canonical_history.main_head_summary: M263 fix RMS-aware Git diff context

active_work.issue_title: GAP-007: COBOL structural edits can duplicate or corrupt nesting
issue_acceptance: Reproduce recorded structural-edit failure on disposable COBOL fixture.
A proposed bounded edit must not duplicate enclosing control/paragraph structure.
Resulting COBOL nesting remains structurally coherent around modified region.
Agent refuses ambiguous structural edit rather than guessing across unsafe boundaries.
Existing exact-text/line bounded-write safety remains intact.
Add focused regression coverage using COBOL fixtures.
Live VMSBBS acceptance confirms original corruption pattern no longer occurs.
compatibility: Preserve OpenVMS COBOL source conventions/storage/calling assumptions.
Do not assume NUL-terminated COBOL data where fixed lengths are used.
Avoid implicit declarations/non-C89 constructs in VAX-facing C.

session_findings.finding: Manual PATCH reproduction accepted duplicate COBOL IF line and produced invalid nesting.
session_findings.bad_edit: Replace one IF A = B with two consecutive IF A = B lines while retaining one END-IF.

session_findings.finding: Manual PROJECT.C project_patch() has a separate RMS defect: fopen(...,"w") + fwrite(flat_buffer) created variable-record files with longest record 1 byte, causing TYPE to print one character per line.
session_findings.evidence: M264_GAP007.COB;1 longest record 33 bytes; PATCH-created ;2 longest record 1 byte.
session_findings.scope_note: Separate from GAP-007 automated-agent structural safety; do not conflate without explicit issue/scope decision.

session_findings.finding: Actual automated agent replace_text/replace_lines implementations are in SRC/OPENAI_TOOLS.C and use edit_txn -> rms_replace_text_file(), so their RMS write path is distinct from manual PATCH.
Plain AGENT is read-only; AGENT/WRITE is guarded write workflow.
Requesty anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5 narrated intent but did not issue the requested tool call for the reproduction.
AGENT/TOOL/RUN cannot directly invoke model-only replace_text; direct table exposes READ, SEARCH, GREP, LIST, TREE, GITSTATUS, GITDIFF, EDIT, PATCH, BUILD, RUN, MCP.
session_findings.implication: A deterministic regression should call execute_replace_text_tool()/validator directly rather than relying on LLM tool selection.

intent.SRC/OPENAI_TOOLS_M264.C: M264 wrapper around existing automated replacement tools so candidate COBOL edits can be validated before existing confirmation/write path.
intent.BUILD_OPENAI_MODULES.COM: Compile guard, compile OPENAI_TOOLS.OBJ from M264 wrapper, build/run M264 regression.
